changes_made.explanation: Removed irrelevant tasks only mentioned in background/literature review (Summarization, MT). Normalized task names from 'Other:X' to standard names. Added CoNLL-2003 specification. Removed redundant output description.
Removed duplicate 'F1 score' (normalized to F1) and kept unique metrics. Paper uses F1 for sequence labeling and accuracy for classification tasks.
No LLM-as-judge evaluation conducted in this paper. T5 is used only for generation, not evaluation.
No human evaluation mentioned in the paper. Only automatic metrics (F1, accuracy) are used for evaluation.

overall_notes: Paper proposes a generative framework for sequence labeling tasks (NER, slot labeling, intent classification) using T5. It generates augmented natural language formats with span markers. Evaluation is entirely automatic using F1 and accuracy metrics. The extraction was generally accurate but included some background/reference items that weren't part of the paper's main contributions.
